title: Blue hour, slow steps
imageAlt: Seoul city street at blue hour
content: We let the evening decide the route. A quiet side street, a warm cup between our hands, and the city turning lavender one window at a time.

title: The island keeps its own weather
imageAlt: Coastal landscape with ocean and cliffs
content: Wind through the grass, salt on the sleeves, and nowhere to be before sunset. Jeju made even our silence feel like a plan.

title: Paper, shadow, green
imageAlt: Traditional Kyoto temple surrounded by greenery
content: We followed the sound of gravel underfoot and found a garden that seemed to have been waiting for us. Every corner held a softer version of the day.

title: A little rain is still a view
imageAlt: Rainy city scene with a leafy view
content: The best plans were the ones made under an awning: noodles, a shared umbrella, and a list of places we could return to later.

title: The city in soft yellow
imageAlt: Warm Lisbon street with colorful buildings
content: Lisbon taught us to look up: tiled walls, laundry in the sun, and the last light resting on every old balcony.

title: Warm rooms, white horizons
imageAlt: Snowy winter landscape under a pale sky
content: Outside was silver and quiet. Inside, we made tea, watched the snow gather, and agreed that winter has its own kind of light.

title: Purple lights after the last train
imageAlt: Seoul street lights glowing after dusk
content: We missed the turn on purpose and found a tiny late-night café washed in violet light. JisooA chose the corner seat, I chose the cake, and neither of us wanted to be the first to leave.

title: Sea air and a table for two
imageAlt: Coastal city view with blue sea
content: We walked the waterfront until the wind made our hair impossible. Dinner was spicy chicken, hot rice and a shared promise to come back when the sky turns colder.

title: Winter, wrapped in orange
imageAlt: Quiet winter trees and pale snow
content: A cold afternoon became our favourite kind of day: warm blankets at the guesthouse, peeled tangerines on the table, and snow gathering quietly beyond the window.

title: One more round
content: JisooA said she would only play one round. Forty minutes and one very serious rematch later, she finally admitted that winning was more important than sightseeing.
